evidence.title: 圆明园买卖街钩沉: the sets of 铺面房
evidence.summary: The three gardens have two shopping streets, 同乐园 and 含经堂, plus small groups of shops elsewhere such as at 北远山村 and behind 西峰秀色. The 铺面房 yard YM59 in the far south-west is none of those named. It fits by name only: its use stays a guess.

evidence.title: 铺面房: forms and scale, for YM59 if shops
evidence.summary: Shop bays are about 3.2 m wide and 4.8 m deep, in rows, with flat-roof 拍子, 牌楼 or two-storey fronts. 含经堂's row: 135.65 m long, 6.3 m deep, 40 bays; A late Yangshi Lei plan of the 同乐园 street marks offices, not shops, in the old shop buildings, so a label 铺面房 need not mean shops at YM59: unproven.
